g.text: BAP1-KO vs control | 106 higher, 50 lower in mutant (Bonferroni p < 0.05) | 23 robust to leave-one-out
20371 genes tested. Significance basis: Bonferroni p < 0.05 (156 genes). Raw p on the y-axis; horizontal lines mark the corrected cutoffs.
Leave-one-out: each gene was refit 8 times, dropping one sample each time. Ringed points retain significance in all 8 refits.
Only 23 of 156 significant genes survive all 8 refits; grey points are not significant
